'''Benetage''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The Outer Rim planet of Benetage was an inhabited world during the eras before the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A government existed on the world, wherein officials took on the title of [[Magistrates of Benetage|Magistrate]]. The symbol of office of the Magistrates was the [[Crown of Verity/Legends|Crown of Verity]], a [[Force artifact/Legends|Force artifact]] which caused its wearer to become a paragon of truth. The planet was depopulated mysteriously circa [[30,000 BBY]], and the Crown fell into obscurity until it turned up in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="NoP" />
